summary: Retain bounded private source qualification refusal causes

replay.detail: No replay, extraction or installation eligibility change.

schema.detail: No production schema or trigger change.

rules.detail: No source, readiness or checkpoint rule change.

compatibility.detail: The scratch vehicle retains bounded setup and Installer phase errors in private stderr; preexec failures produce an unavailable result with no executed child exit code.

downtime.detail: No daemon or deployed source is changed by the scratch runner.

manual.detail: Any later attempt requires its existing authorization, a new consistent scratch backup and supported resource limits; no retry or limit waiver is introduced.

recovery.detail: Failed scratch attempts remain single-use and retained for diagnosis; generic earlier failures cannot acquire retrospective causes.
